title: Add S3 backup uploader for payment receipts
description: Adds a quick uploader so payment receipts get pushed to the backups bucket nightly. Tested locally.
author: m.osei

files_changed.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/payments-api/src/jobs/backup_receipts.py
@@
+import boto3
+import logging
+import psycopg2
+
+log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID = "AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE"
+AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY = "wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY"
+DB_CONN = "postgresql://payments:Sup3rS3cret!@ledger-db.internal:5432/payments"
+
+def run_backup():
+    s3 = boto3.client(
+        "s3",
+        aws_access_key_id=AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID,
+        aws_secret_access_key=AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY,
+    )
+    conn = psycopg2.connect(DB_CONN)
+    cur = conn.cursor()
+    cur.execute("SELECT id, customer_email, payload FROM receipts WHERE backed_up = false")
+    for row in cur.fetchall():
+        receipt_id, email, payload = row
+        log.debug(f"Uploading receipt for user: {{'id': {receipt_id}, 'email': '{email}', 'payload': {payload}}}")
+        s3.put_object(Bucket="receipts-backup", Key=f"{receipt_id}.json", Body=payload)
+    conn.close()
